rich-text-editor.$description: RichTextEditor. The editor is a form field, so its frame speaks the same language as Input and Textarea: the 3:1 control boundary, the field corner, the field focus treatment. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens.

border.$description: The editable frame's boundary — the control boundary every field uses, at 3:1 against the surfaces it sits on.

border-readonly.$description: A read-only editor keeps a quiet, decorative frame: it still bounds the content, but no longer claims to be a control you can type into.

background.$description: The editing surface takes the surface it is placed on, like every Qeetrix field.

toolbar-background.$description: The formatting strip sits one quiet step off the editing surface, so chrome and content read as two layers without a heavier rule between them.

divider.$description: Rules between the toolbar, the link bar and the content.

caret.$description: The text caret. Brand, because the caret is where focus is and focus is Qeet orange; the brand border role is designed at 3:1 or better on every surface, so the caret meets non-text contrast in both themes.
